text.en:
Today you learn words like myself.
I cut myself.
She hurt herself.
He blamed himself.
The person does it, and it comes back to the same person.

I: myself. You: yourself.
He: himself. She: herself.
We: ourselves. They: themselves.
Many people? Then selves.
We introduced ourselves.
You can help yourself.

You will say I did it on my own.
I fixed the tap myself.
She wrote the letter herself.
You will say by myself too.
It means alone.
She lives by herself.
